files.name: IMG_4942.jpg
files.disposition: Volume-one ending stresses personal agency and introduces volume two. No executable progression rule on this page.

files.name: IMG_4943.jpg
files.disposition: Volume-two Architect's Note says the work was split from a 1043-page original with continuous Arabic numbering. Roman front matter is a distinct identifier, not Arabic page 5.

files.name: IMG_4947.jpg
files.disposition: Continuation of the volume-two preface; methodological confidence remains an author claim, not software or scientific validation.

files.name: IMG_4948.jpg
files.disposition: Architect note says it was added after initial copies, links the Astrology and Cosmodynamics names, and says these volumes are not an application manual. No formula erratum is supplied.

files.name: IMG_4949.jpg
files.disposition: Closing architect note continues on Roman viii. Camera order must not be used as Arabic page numbering.

files.name: IMG_4950.jpg
files.disposition: Dynamic chapter opening discusses purpose of application; no progression computation convention appears in this passage.

files.name: IMG_4951.jpg
files.disposition: Introductory personal application anecdotes precede progression material. Anecdotes are not independent numerical fixtures or empirical validation.

files.name: IMG_4952.jpg
files.disposition: Progression opening describes roughly one degree of Sun motion per year corresponding to one day, with other bodies at their own relative pace. It explicitly requires simultaneous natal, progressed and relocated charts. Exact year/day units and angles are not specified.

files.name: IMG_4954.jpg
files.disposition: Progression Ascendant-flip anecdotes continue into Transits; relocated chart equals natal if location is unchanged. Anecdotes do not supply an angular algorithm or event fixture.

files.name: IMG_4955.jpg
files.disposition: Introduces predictions with a warning that distant forecasts lack context; autobiographical success claims remain author claims.

files.name: IMG_4956.jpg
files.disposition: Continues claimed past prediction successes; no dated reproducible chart inputs or progression timescale are provided here.

files.name: IMG_4957.jpg
files.disposition: Transit is incoming sky influence; Venus contact is not a guarantee of money. The source requires surrounding sky conditions rather than an isolated body label.

files.name: IMG_4958.jpg
files.disposition: Transit sign alignment alone does not aspect an entire natal house; actual contacts to occupants or angles are required. Do not predict medical or life events from the author's anecdote.

files.name: IMG_4959.jpg
files.disposition: Cosmic Dance starts by assessing each current-sky body's own relationships before personal overlays.

files.name: IMG_4960.jpg
files.disposition: Transit condition includes relationships and rulership payloads; source illustrates directional notation and a hand-off without supplying a universal event algorithm.

files.name: IMG_4961.jpg
files.disposition: Return is a cycle kickstart rather than a fixed forecast for the whole cycle. Transit and synastry discussions reject control over the sky or another person.

files.name: IMG_4962.jpg
files.disposition: Two diagrams distinguish Moon in H4 applying toward natal Sun H5 from Moon in H6 on the other side; direction changes the proposed resolution.

files.name: IMG_4963.jpg
files.disposition: Clean 30-degree semi-sextile is illustrative, may occur within or across houses, and still needs OOI. Scenario A centers support in the transit Moon territory.

files.name: IMG_4964.jpg
files.disposition: Repeats both diagrams and reverses ordering for scenario B, natal Sun toward transit Moon in H6. Keep receiver and source perspectives explicit.

files.name: IMG_4965.jpg
files.disposition: Scenario B requires intentional reach into unfamiliar transit territory. This is a contextual example, not a universal orb or deterministic event rule.

files.name: IMG_4966.jpg
files.disposition: Dynamic chart approach requires inner, static and outer layers plus transits to all. Source rhetoric does not supply a complete calculation specification.

files.name: IMG_4967.jpg
files.disposition: Three small wheel diagrams and ordered labels show progressed inner, natal center and relocated outer; discusses geographical and communication connections. Fine wheel coordinates are not transcribed from this overview.

files.name: IMG_4968.jpg
files.disposition: Three-layer diagram is explicitly progressed, natal and relocated; progressed MC 14:50, natal MC 3:25 and relocated MC 10:57. Do not use rounded prose 15 as a precise progression fixture.

files.name: IMG_4969.jpg
files.disposition: Sign spill 1.5 degrees yields 5 percent; decan spill 30 arcminutes and degree spill 3 arcminutes. First/last wording and preview anecdote do not settle full before/after weights or retrograde timing.

files.name: IMG_4970.jpg
files.disposition: Progressed MC 14:50 Gemini H10 and Mercury 2:28 Leo H12 are each labelled Gemini Spark. Both conflict with the later house-parity procedure; preserve as examples.

files.name: IMG_4971.jpg
files.disposition: Original retains Austin MC 10:57 Aquarius Spark/Pisces FCA and Mars 5:56 Pisces Spark/Aries FCA. Mars is four arcminutes before 6, conflicting with stated three-arcminute width; parity contradiction survives.

files.name: IMG_4972.JPG
files.disposition: Los Angeles example gives MC 18:39 Pisces H9, Aries Spark, and Neptune 25:48 Sagittarius H6, Taurus Spark. It does not remove the competing Spark examples.

files.name: IMG_4973.JPG
files.disposition: Narrative forecasts progressed MC entering Cancer Spark FCA in mid-July without a reproducible epoch in this passage. Does not settle exact activation or unit conventions.

files.name: IMG_4974.JPG
files.disposition: Defines transit return to the natal degree and criticizes reading a return chart as a whole-cycle forecast. Exact boundary ownership remains unspecified.

files.name: IMG_4975.JPG
files.disposition: Aspect resonance is tied to natal rather than relocated energies, lasts a short phase, and retains natal linkage; seven major aspects are referenced without a complete timing algorithm here.
